phase-summary.outcome: Phase 58 terminology is now locked with the user's actual model. `Level` is the shared loadable concept, `room` remains a real authored concept, region-levels contain town, wilderness, outskirts, and dungeon structure, DungeonBreak extends Escape the Dungeon, and Unreal uses a hybrid browser-plus-optional-managed-placement workflow.

file.description: Revised to use the level-centered model and region-level semantics instead of invented neutral vocabulary.
Revised to use levels, rooms, transitions, and level content as the project/editor vocabulary.
Revised to lock the hybrid Unreal workflow: browser and drag-drop first, deterministic managed placement later where useful.
Decision log now matches the approved phase-58 model and no longer relies on the earlier invented primitive vocabulary.

decision.summary: Region-level is the parent structure for town, wilderness, outskirts, and dungeon structure.
decision.impact: Keeps the world model coherent and avoids fragmenting those concepts into disconnected top-level roots.

decision.summary: Unreal starts with a hybrid workflow rather than mandatory auto-placement.
decision.impact: The plugin can be useful sooner and grow into managed deterministic placement later.

tests.test: XML parse validation for revised phase-58 plans, summary, and decisions.

next.action: Phase 58 is locked. Future implementation work can now follow the approved level-centered model and hybrid Unreal workflow.

suggestion.gap: REQUIREMENTS.xml still lacks the locked level-centered world model and hybrid Unreal workflow language.
suggestion.proposal: Add a requirement that level is the shared loadable concept, region-levels contain town/wilderness/outskirts/dungeon structure, rooms remain first-class authored concepts, and Unreal starts with a hybrid browser-plus-optional-managed-placement workflow.
